channelTitle: That little brown bottle in Grandma June's cabinet isn't just for cuts
hook: That little brown bottle from the medicine cabinet has more than one use, and one of them has nothing to do with scrapes.
remedy: A few drops of hydrogen peroxide diluted with water is an old home remedy some people use to help soften built-up earwax before it's gently rinsed out.
steps: Dilute hydrogen peroxide with an equal amount of water
Tilt your head and place a few drops in the ear canal using a dropper
Let it bubble for a few minutes, then tilt your head to let it drain onto a tissue
caution: Never use this if there's any chance of a punctured eardrum or if you have ear pain, discharge, or a history of ear infections - see a doctor instead.
cta: Have you tried this one, or does a doctor's visit feel safer to you? Let Grandma June know.
